about: Round RPG4: the RPG's numbers - gold, prices, rewards, shop stock. EVERY value here is a placeholder (Claude's estimate, 12 Oct 2026); the plan leaves prices, the share of gold lost and reward rates open, to be tuned while Karl plays the slice. Karl's own numbers so far: basic lands are bought, 1 gold each (13 Oct, Round RPG7); a lost duel takes a share of the gold you carry by kind of fight, regular 5%, dungeon 10%, boss 20%, never more than 20% (3 Nov, Round GOLD1: loss_gold_share - one number still means the same share for every kind; the foe you lost to holds the gold until you beat it). Round PACK1 (3 Nov 2026): jumpstart_price, premium_pack_price, bundle_price (three plain packs at once) and jumpstart_stock (theme packs a shop has) are Claude's placeholders until prog-tune; jumpstart_price was raised from 60 to 90 because a Brackwater theme pack's cards sell back for 68.5 gold on average (claude/PACK1_2026-11-03.md section 4). Karl 4 Nov 2026, after the 8 h soak (claude/PROG_TUNE_OVERNIGHT_2026-11-04.md): option A's gold, shelf and restock with GOLD1's loss shares by kind (tools/rpg_soak_settings/option_a_gold1) - a regular foe pays 40-80 gold (was 20-40), a shop restocks after 3 duels (was 5) and keeps 4 tier-3 singles (was 2). Round STARTER1 (Karl 4 Nov 2026, "Upgrade picked halves"): starter_upgrade - each picked Jumpstart half-deck of a new game gives up per_half of its weakest spells for stronger cards of the same type and mana value (within 1), its colours, up to max_tier (rpg/starter.py); per_half 3 is the smallest whose starting decks reach a median Card quality of 1.7 (5,000 sampled decks: 1.72; claude/STARTER1_2026-11-05.md), max_tier 3 is the brief's estimate (tier 4-5 stay rewards). Round STARTER1B (Karl 7 Nov 2026, "Stronger: 4 swaps" and "Only Moat"): per_half 4 (12 of the 60), and never - card names never chosen as an upgrade (each must be a card of the pool; claude/STARTER1B_2026-11-07.md). rpg/economy.py checks this file when it is read and names any key it can't use.
